data.body: Additional live cap exercise 2026-09-09T03:20Z: rebar-docker-buildkit-cache-high correctly alarmed when BuildKit cache reached 91% of its 5 GiB share. I exercised the reclaim path with docker builder prune --filter until=24h, which reclaimed 1.029 GB and reduced BuildKit cache from 4.938 GB (91%) to 3.908 GB (72%). A manual observability run published the fresh datapoint; CloudWatch alarm transitioned OK at 2026-09-09T03:25:21Z. This verifies both the cap metric/alarm wiring and the operational reclaim path.
